# Throuly Scout

> Privacy-first homebuying tools — affordability calculators, financial health scoring, property analysis, and assistance program discovery across all 50 US states.

Throuly Scout helps homebuyers navigate the purchase process end to end: calculating what they can truly afford, scoring their financial readiness, analyzing properties and markets with AI, and finding down-payment assistance and first-time buyer programs.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Throuly Scout and its buyer tools.
- [Buyers](/buyers): Step-by-step home affordability calculator across all 50 states with DTI-based loan options.
- [Financial Health](/homebuying-estimate/financial-health): Composite financial readiness score with factor-by-factor guidance.
- [Assistance Programs](/buyers/programs): AI-generated down-payment assistance and first-time buyer grants.
- [Scout](/scout): Product overview — search, match, and underwrite properties privately.
- [How It Works](/how-it-works): The Throuly Scout process from estimate to purchase.
- [Analyzer](/analyzer): AI-powered address and property analysis with market intelligence.
- [Property Search](/properties/search): Search active listings across the platform.
- [Resources](/resources): Educational articles, calculators, and market guides.
- [News](/news): Product updates and market news.
- [Trust](/trust): Privacy and data-handling practices.
- [Try it Free](/try-it-free): Free access to core Throuly Scout tools.

## Guides

- [Buyers Guide](/guides/buyers): How to prepare, qualify, and close as a homebuyer.
- [Investors Guide](/guides/investors): Rental yield, NOI, cap rate, and cash-on-cash analysis.
- [Realistic Affordability](/guides/realistic-affordability): Why 28% front-end DTI beats lender maximums.
- [Smart Buyer Strategies](/guides/smart-buyer-strategies): Negotiation and timing tactics for buyers.
